trigger.observed_impossibility: the invalid output reports zero candidates in both arms although audit-valid submit_and_replay pass events exist
trigger.root_cause: the analyzer reads replay program_sha256 and certificate from result, while normalized soft replay feedback stores both fields in result.raw_evidence

repair_contract.allowed_change: read the same program_sha256 and certificate fields from either the legacy result level or normalized result.raw_evidence, then apply the frozen exact-hash candidate definition
repair_contract.required_regression_test: a normalized replay pass is a candidate only when raw_evidence.program_sha256 equals raw_evidence.certificate.program_sha256
repair_contract.invalid_output_policy: retain for audit but never use for claims
